The *Sampakkhandanalakkhaṇasaddhāpañha* ("The Question on Aspiration", Mil 3.1.11) is a doctrinal dialogue in the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. It addresses the characteristic of faith (*saddhā*) as aspiration or striving forward (*sampakkhandana-lakkhaṇa*), forming a conceptual pair with the preceding section on faith as serene clarity (*sampasādana-lakkhaṇa*, Mil 3.1.10) [SuttaCentral]. It has been translated into English by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral identifies a direct parallel in the Chinese *Nāgasena-sūtra* tradition at T 1670b 2.9 ("Aspiration of faith") [SuttaCentral]. Related verses and passages on faith are also noted in connection with the *Āḷavaka Sutta* (SN 10.12 / Snp 1.10), Sanskrit and Tibetan recensions of the *Udānavarga* (UV 10, UVS 10, Uv Kg 10), Chinese parallels (T 210.4, T 212.11, T 213.10), and the *Śarīrārthagāthā* [SuttaCentral].
